title: CBIC Streamlines EDF Authentication for Exports from Non-EDI Customs Locations
content:
# CBIC Streamlines EDF Authentication for Exports from Non-EDI Customs Locations

Ek important update hai! Government ne Non-EDI Customs locations se hone wale exports ke liye Export Declaration Forms (EDF) ke authentication aur forwarding process ko streamline karne ke liye directions announce kiye hain.

Yeh ek crucial move hai under the new Foreign Exchange Management (Export and Import of Goods and Services) Regulations, 2026, jo October 1, 2026 se effective ho chuke hain.

**Key Highlights of the CBIC Instruction:**

*   **What's New:** The Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) ne Instruction No. 19/2026-Customs, dated October 5, 2026, issue kiya hai. Is instruction mein Non-EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) Customs locations par Export Declaration Forms (EDFs) ke authentication aur forwarding ke liye ek naya mechanism prescribed kiya gaya hai.
*   **Purpose:** Jab exports Non-EDI ports ke through hote hain, toh exporters ko specified authority (jaise Commissioner of Customs in the Domestic Tariff Area - DTA) ko physical EDF submit karna hota hai authentication ke liye. Authenticated EDFs phir concerned Authorised Dealer (AD) ko forward kiye jaayenge.
*   **Operational Date:** Yeh naya mechanism October 1, 2026 se operational hai, which is also the date from which the Foreign Exchange Management (Export and Import of Goods and Services) Regulations, 2026 came into force.
*   **Role of Commissioners:** All Commissioners of Customs ko apne jurisdiction mein Non-EDI Customs locations ko identify karne aur is process ko operationalize karne ke liye bola gaya hai.
*   **Electronic Transmission:** Jahan tak practicable ho, authenticated EDFs ko single official Government email address se electronically transmit karne ko prioritise kiya jayega, to minimize risk of misuse or forged documents.
*   **RBI's Initiative:** Reserve Bank of India (RBI) bhi Authorised Dealers ko yeh authenticated EDFs receive karne ke liye ek single nodal point arrange kar raha hai. Iski details baad mein circulate ki jayengi.

Yeh step exports ki compliance aur ease of doing business ko badhane mein help karega.
